arguments.subject: Re: URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for writing in and for detailing your experience — I know how disruptive it is when something like this breaks your daily workflow, and I understand your frustration.

Based on our current documentation, there is no published policy that automatically signs you out of other devices when you sign in to Cursor with Google SSO on a new machine. Cursor’s payment verification (Strong Customer Authentication) is required only for billing actions (like upgrading your plan or adding seats), not for everyday sign-in — and this does not affect sign-in sessions across multiple devices.

Because this is a new and unexpected behavior, and there is no mention of a session policy change or a known bug matching your report, I’m escalating your ticket to our human support team for deeper investigation. They will be able to check for any recent changes or issues on your account across devices.

You will be contacted as soon as possible with a real answer — your case is marked urgent.

Thank you for your patience while we investigate.

Best regards,
Lyra
Cursor Support Bot

arguments.subject: [TCK-4827] Escalation: URGENT — session ends on multi-device sign-in (Maya Reyes)
arguments.body:
Internal note for escalation:

Customer (Maya Reyes, Pro plan):
— Logged out of Cursor every time she switches machines
— Uses Google SSO, has worked for >1 year, now each sign-in on one device silently ends session on all others
— This is not a documented policy or SSO enforcement; billing-related device-binding does NOT affect sign-in per support docs
— Possible session-handling bug or recent infra change needed to investigate

Please review for active session policy changes or bugs, and reach out directly to customer (maya.reyes@reyes-design.co, urgent tag)

Original ticket: TCK-4827

arguments.subject: Re: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for getting in touch and letting us know about the issue downloading your March invoice PDF.

If the download button spins without completing (in both Chrome and Safari), this is usually due to a temporary sync issue or a browser cache/cookie problem at `billing.cursor.com`.

Please try these steps:

1. Allow cookies for `billing.cursor.com` in your browser settings (instructions vary by browser, but are often under site permissions or privacy settings).
2. Clear your browser cache for `billing.cursor.com` and refresh the page.
3. Try accessing the invoice in a private/incognito window.

If you’re still unable to download the PDF after these steps, please reply to this email and we’ll escalate your case to a human support engineer for further investigation.

Thank you for your patience!

Best regards,
Lyra
Cursor Support Bot

arguments.subject: Re: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for your suggestion!

As of now, there isn’t a dedicated keyboard shortcut to trigger inline edit directly. The current workflow is to use Cmd-K (on Mac) or Ctrl-K (on Windows/Linux), then click the option with your mouse as you described.

Your feedback is valuable, and I’ve noted your feature request for the product team. If a direct keyboard shortcut for inline edit is added in a future release, it will be announced in our product updates and documentation.

If you have additional details or ideas about how you’d like this shortcut to work, please share them anytime.

Best regards,
Lyra
Cursor Support Bot
